about: Private boat trips from Marina do Funchal, Madeira. Day Trip with a swim stop, Sunset Trip along Cabo Girão. Just your group, five guests max, skipper included. Photos and video of your trip included. Free cancellation up to 24 h.
description:
Chifbay runs private boat trips from Marina do Funchal, Madeira. The whole boat is yours: just your group, up to five guests, with a skipper. No shared tours, no crowds.

DAY TRIP (2h30 or 3h, departs 10:00 or 14:00)
Câmara de Lobos, then Cabo Girão seen from the sea, then a swim and paddle stop at Fajã dos Padres, and Ribeira Brava on the way back. The 3h trip goes 30 minutes further west to Ponta do Sol. Food on board.

SUNSET TRIP (2h or 2h30)
Leaves 1h15 before the sun goes down, so the light is right all year. The same coast, turning at Cabo Girão (2h) or Ribeira Brava (2h30). No swimming on this one: the water is too cold that late. Food on board.

INCLUDED ON EVERY TRIP
An Insta360 360° video of your trip, drone footage when the weather allows, and photos taken with a real camera. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.

BOOK
chifbay.com, or message us on WhatsApp: +351 937 200 320.
Meeting point: Marina do Funchal, 9000 Funchal, Madeira, Portugal.
